details: Oil prices have fallen as hopes for diplomatic progress on the US-Iran conflict emerge ahead of this week's UN General Assembly. President Trump has indicated openness to meeting Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian. Despite this, Iran's military warned of retaliation if the US resumes strikes, and Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure remain a risk. Saudi Arabia is rerouting some oil exports via the Red Sea due to Strait of Hormuz risks.
title: Middle East Tensions and Oil Prices Decline Ahead of UN Diplomacy

details: Ukraine conducted its largest-ever drone attack on Moscow and surrounding areas, targeting an oil refinery, as Russia's parliamentary elections concluded. Authorities reported shooting down over 1,900 drones, with at least two people killed and significant damage to the Gazprom Neft Moscow Oil Refinery. Ukrainian President Zelensky praised the attack, stating long-range responses had a significant impact.
title: Ukraine Launches Major Drone Attack on Moscow Amid Russian Elections

details: US President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping are scheduled to hold a summit in Washington this week, with discussions expected to cover trade, critical minerals, and artificial intelligence. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent met with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng in preparation for the visit, with initial talks described as "very successful" on trade and AI.
title: US-China Summit and AI Discussions

details: Bitcoin surged past $81,000 following the SEC's approval for on-chain trading of tokenized U.S. stocks. This regulatory development triggered a short squeeze and contributed to weekend gains for Bitcoin and a 23% rally for NEAR Protocol. Spot Bitcoin ETFs also saw a net inflow of $433 million on Friday, leading to a modest weekly net inflow for September after a volatile month.
title: SEC Approves Tokenized US Stocks, Boosting Bitcoin

details: The cryptocurrency industry's push for a comprehensive U.S. regulatory framework suffered a setback as the Senate rejected the CLARITY Act, failing to secure the 60 votes needed to advance. This bill aimed to establish clearer rules for digital assets and had been a subject of extensive negotiations. The failure highlighted industry infighting and competing legislative priorities like the war in Iran and inflation.
title: US Senate Rejects CLARITY Act for Crypto Regulation

details: The Federal Reserve hiked interest rates last week for the first time in three years, and Minneapolis Federal Reserve President Neel Kashkari indicated that US inflation has broadened beyond just oil prices, now showing up widely across the services sector. Most Fed governors expect another rate hike by year-end, driven by renewed resilience in the labor market and consumer demand.
title: Federal Reserve Rate Hike and Broadening Inflation

details: An exploit on Fetch.ai's (FET) token converter on Ethereum resulted in approximately $1.56 million worth of FET being drained. Security firms reported that an attacker used a valid authorization signature to call the conversionIn function on the TokenConversionManagerV3 contract. The incident also affected NuNet (NTX) as part of a coordinated $2 million attack.
title: Fetch.ai Token Converter Exploit
